title: One yard. A very short field.
summary: Leading 17–10, the Chargers failed on fourth-and-1 at their own 41. Denver tied the game on the ensuing short field and eventually won 23–17.

timeline.label: 10:33 remaining
timeline.text: Jim Harbaugh kept the offense on the field on fourth down.

timeline.label: The attempt
timeline.text: Denver stopped Justin Herbert’s quarterback sneak.

timeline.label: Afterward
timeline.text: Denver scored a tying touchdown; later Herbert turnovers preceded two field goals.

unusual: The location made a failed attempt especially costly. A failed conversion alone does not establish that every fourth-down attempt in this situation is wrong.
explanations: Harbaugh accepted responsibility and said the defensive alignment should have prompted a timeout and punt. No proprietary analytics recommendation was verified.
questions: What conversion estimate and defensive look informed the original call?

potential_bets.impact: The failed conversion helped set up Denver's comeback; a Chargers win ticket would lose on the final result.
